intelligence.essence: The current booking is "complete mess, not useful at all" — so keep NOTHING of it. Not a patch, not a salvage, not the good bits carried over: a rebuild, as the ultimate booking app inside the calendar page, built from the citizen's own steps — kind → day → real open time → how → name + one line → one Book button → confirmation + Smart Mail + reminder → one-tap change/cancel, both calendars, no double-booking. Patching a mess preserves the mess; the rebuild starts from the flow, never from the old code.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine your toy box is all tangled up, sweetheart — so tangled you can't find anything or play with any of it! You don't just wiggle one toy, sweetheart — you tip the whole box out and build it fresh, step by step, one, two, three, so every toy has its place and you can play right away!
intelligence.grandma_view: It's like this, love — when a thing is a complete mess, dear, you don't keep polishing the mess and hoping it turns tidy. You set it aside, love, and you build it fresh from the steps a person actually takes — what kind, what day, what time, how, your name, one little line, one button, and done, dear. Simple steps, in order, and nothing extra standing in the way.
